decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development results in a loss of amenity and privacy to the adjoining residential property. This is contrary to Policy ENV.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted UDP and Policy ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) of the Revised Deposit UDP.

Condition : 2 - The loss of the use of the garage for parking purposes results in parking outside the curtilage of the site to the detriment of the appearance and character of the property, adjoining properties and the character and appearance of the Conservation Area and also results in conditions prejudicial to the free flow of traffic and general safety of road users. This is contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 (All New Development), ENV.1.2 (Conservation Areas), T.2.5 (Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.3.5 (Pedestrian Safety and Security) of the Adopted UDP and Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and servicing Facilities for Developments) and T.2.2 (Pedestrian Safety and Security) of the Revised Deposit UDP.
description: Retention of use of garage as a habitable room and retention of flank window with the introduction of obscure glazing contrary to condition 4 (garage use) of approved permission dated 13/4/89
